## About

Emre Toprak is a Head of AI Engineering and fintech architect with 20+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, financial systems, distributed systems and technical leadership.

The website contains static English and Turkish profiles. Use the page matching the reader's language as the primary source; both pages describe the same professional identity.

## Expertise

- AI engineering and agentic AI systems
- Generative AI and production-grade LLM applications
- Domain-specific LLMs and financial AI
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Agent orchestration with LangChain, LangGraph and Langflow
- AI-native software engineering and developer tooling
- Scalable distributed systems and fintech architecture
- Engineering quality automation and AI observability
